data.jobDescription:
Job Title:

Director - Process Management

Work Type:

Permanent

Location:

Gurugram, India

It’s more than a career at NAB. It’s about more meaningful work, more global opportunities and more innovation beyond boundaries .

Your job is just one part of your life. When you bring your ideas, energy, and hunger for growth, you’ll be recognised and rewarded for your contribution in return. You’ll have our support to excel for our customers, deliver positive change for our communities and grow your career.

NAB has established NAB Innovation Centre India as a centre for operations and technology excellence to support NAB deliver faster, better, and more personalized experience to customers and colleagues.

At NAB India, we’re ramping-up and growing at a very fast pace. Our passionate leaders recruit and develop high performing people, empowering them to deliver exceptional outcomes to make a positive difference in the lives of our customers and our communities.

Process Management COE is accountable for leading and embedding enterprise business process management and controls in line with NAB Standards. Process Management and Knowledge Management including delivery of Content Management standards across Enterprise Operations (EO). Ensuring strong end‑to‑end process governance and uplift of process maturity aligned to risk, controls, and regulatory obligations.

The role provides strategic and people leadership to the Process Management COE, with clear delivery accountability to enable Process and Model Owners to meet their obligations, drive continuous improvement, and strengthen operational resilience. Through strong governance including adherence to Change Risk Process, Modelling standards, and assurance, the role also ensures operational content, including work instructions, is consistently documented, maintained, and accurately reflective of EO processes in line with best practice.

Key Accountabilities - 

•Embed and sustain enterprise process management standards (PACE) and Ab standards across Enterprise Operations 

•Uplift end‑to‑end process maturity and governance outcomes across EO 

•Reduce process quality issues through the implementation of effective controls

•Enable timely identification, escalation and remediation of process and control risks 

•Ensure consistent, high‑quality work instruction documentation aligned to approved process models 

•Support the change risk process and alignment to change governance standards

•Improve the currency, clarity and usability of work instructions across EO
